# January 2019 shorebird survey

Volunteers counted 5,750 shorebirds of 70 species over 10 days in January 2019. The survey covered 51 kilometres of shoreline with 29 volunteers.

## Most common species

| Species | Count |
|---|---|
| Little stint | 4,811 |
| Lesser sand plover | 5,215 |
| Common redshank | 793 |

## Notable sighting

A single spoon-billed sandpiper was recorded on the fourth day of the survey, the first at Coral Ridge since 2014.
